text:
Nina: Hey! Day 1 done. Quick checklist so I don't spam: where do I post for badge pickup, VPN setup, laptop issues, repo access, cloud/project access, and how to mute the onboarding bot?
IT Support: Welcome Nina :tada: Short guide: badge -> #people-ops (include full name + office). VPN -> #help with 'vpn' in subject + your region. Laptop/hardware -> #eng-infra (attach serial & OS). Repo perms -> Access Form (link pinned in #devex) then ping @DevEx if it stalls. Cloud/GCP access -> #eng-infra with project id & role. For urgent blockers DM me.
Nina: Thanks! If something is team-specific (like a test repo), should I post in my team channel first?
DevEx: Yes, start in your team channel for team-scoped requests. If infra needs to intervene, summarize outcome and copy the Access Form ticket to #devex or #eng-infra. That helps audit.
Maya: Etiquette tips: use threads to keep channels tidy, react with :thumbsup: for ack, avoid @here/@channel unless it's a real outage or full-office ask. If you need attention fast, tag the person rather than the whole channel.
OnboardBot: Commands: `/onboard prefs` opens DM with toggles, `/onboard pause 7d` pauses DMs for 7 days, `/onboard stop` unsubscribes. Click "Manage" in the welcome DM to set cadence.
Nina: Where do I put logs or long traces? I don't want to paste huge dumps in the channel.
IT Support: Put long logs in a Gist or Google Drive link and post the link with a 1-line summary. Use triple backticks for small snippets:
```
error: permission denied on clone
steps: attempted ssh key, tried https
```
Post that in #eng-infra and tag the oncall if urgent.
Alex (People Ops): Badge note: if you're remote and need an access card mailed, DM People Ops with shipping address and start date. Badge requests are typically processed in 2 business days.
Nina: One last thing — social posts like lunch invites?
Maya: #lunch-plans for food meetups, #random for memes/socials. Both fine.
Nina: Awesome, this helps a ton. I'll follow up in-thread if anything pops up :smile:
